docker/docker-compose.yaml.contents:
services:
  ur_container:
    build:
      context: ../
      dockerfile: ./docker/Dockerfile
      # Requires the heavy base image to exist first (built once):
      #   docker build -f docker/Dockerfile.base -t urmir-jazzy-base:latest .
      # run_docker.sh builds it automatically if missing.
      args:
        BASE_IMAGE: urmir-jazzy-base:latest
    image: urmir-jazzy:latest
    container_name: urmir-jazzy        # stable name in `docker ps` (no docker-<dir>-1 prefix/suffix)
    hostname: urmir-jazzy              # stable in-container hostname (prompt + ROS log paths)
    ports:
      - "10000:10000"
      - "50001-50004:50001-50004"
    environment:
      - DISPLAY=${DISPLAY}  # Forward host display
      - QT_X11_NO_MITSHM=1  # Avoid MIT-SHM errors
    volumes:
      - /tmp/.X11-unix:/tmp/.X11-unix:rw    
    privileged: true         # Optional, but sometimes needed for drivers
    stdin_open: true       # equivalent to -it
    tty: true              # for interactive shell
    command: /bin/bash
    restart: "no"          # don't restart after exit

docker/Dockerfile.contents:
# Thin application image.
#
# The heavy MoveIt2 / MTC / ROS-TCP-Endpoint build lives in the base image
# (docker/Dockerfile.base -> urmir-jazzy-base:latest) and is reused here, so this image
# only compiles the application packages in ros_ws/src. That makes day-to-day rebuilds fast.
#
# Build the base image first (once):
#   docker build -f docker/Dockerfile.base -t urmir-jazzy-base:latest .
# Then build/run this image via docker compose (see docker/run_docker.sh).

ARG BASE_IMAGE=urmir-jazzy-base:latest
FROM ${BASE_IMAGE}

SHELL ["/bin/bash", "-c"]

WORKDIR /home/ros_ws

# Copy ROS2 application packages into the workspace.
# build/, install/ and log/ are excluded via .dockerignore, so the pre-compiled MoveIt
# artifacts inherited from the base image are preserved.
COPY ./ros_ws /home/ros_ws
COPY ./docker /home/docker

RUN rosdep update
RUN apt-get update && source /opt/ros/jazzy/setup.sh && rosdep install --from-paths src --ignore-src -r -y --rosdistro $ROS_DISTRO

# Incremental build: MoveIt2/MTC/ROS-TCP-Endpoint are already built (and unchanged) in the
# base image, so colcon only compiles the application packages here.
RUN source /opt/ros/jazzy/setup.sh && colcon build --cmake-args -G Ninja -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release

# Change to workspace on sign in
RUN echo "cd /home/ros_ws" >> ~/.bashrc

# Source
RUN echo "source /opt/ros/jazzy/setup.bash" >> ~/.bashrc && echo ". install/setup.bash" >> ~/.bashrc && echo "PS1='${debian_chroot:+($debian_chroot)}\[\033[01;32m\]\u@\h\[\033[00m\]:\[\033[01;93m\]\w\[\e[1;32m\]$(parse_git_branch)\[\e[1;37m\]\$ '" >> ~/.bashrc

## Source the workspace on sign in
##RUN echo ". install/local_setup.bash" >> ~/.bashrc

docker/run_docker.sh.contents:
#!/bin/bash
set -e

# Resolve paths so this works regardless of the current working directory.
SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
REPO_ROOT="$(cd "$SCRIPT_DIR/.." && pwd)"

BASE_IMAGE=urmir-jazzy-base:latest
MODE="${1:-up}"   # "up" (default): build + run;  "build": build images only

# Build the heavy base image (MoveIt2 + MTC + ROS-TCP-Endpoint) once if missing.
# No display needed for this; safe over SSH.
# To force a rebuild later (e.g. after changing the pinned MoveIt/MTC versions), run:
#   docker build -f docker/Dockerfile.base -t urmir-jazzy-base:latest .
if ! docker image inspect "$BASE_IMAGE" > /dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "Base image $BASE_IMAGE not found."
  echo "Building it once now (slow: compiles MoveIt2 + MTC from source)..."
  docker build -f "$REPO_ROOT/docker/Dockerfile.base" -t "$BASE_IMAGE" "$REPO_ROOT"
fi

if [ "$MODE" = "build" ]; then
  echo "Build-only mode: building the app image (not starting the container)."
  docker compose -f "$SCRIPT_DIR/docker-compose.yaml" build
  exit 0
fi

# Run mode: grant the container access to the host X server for GUI apps (rviz, etc.).
# Needed when running at the machine; safely skipped when building over SSH (no DISPLAY).
if [ -n "$DISPLAY" ]; then
  xhost +local:docker || true
else
  echo "DISPLAY not set; skipping xhost (GUI apps won't display). Fine for building over SSH."
fi

# Build the thin app image (fast: only the application packages) and start the container.
docker compose -f "$SCRIPT_DIR/docker-compose.yaml" up --build
